I can't compute the embedded emissions yet because the CN code is missing. The ruleset requires a good CN code that appears in the factor table, and "steel goods" doesn't identify one.

The table has three India entries, each with a different default SEE, so the CN code determines the result:

| CN code | Good | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) | Emissions for 3,000 t (tCO2e) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen, in pigs, blocks or other primary forms | 2.53 | 7,590.00 |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel (excl. remelted scrap ingots) | 2.64 | 7,920.00 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 4.32 | 12,960.00 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations, ribs, etc. | 4.27 | 12,810.00 |

These are illustrative only. Please confirm the CN code for the goods produced, and I'll compute the total for that code. The figures above are 3,000 t × the India SEE, so no rounding is involved.
